title: Debug cart totals and coupons
summary: Find the defects in a cart calculator that mishandles quantities, discount thresholds, and rounding.
objectives: Reproduce a defect with a focused input instead of guessing.
Distinguish an off-by-one threshold from a rounding defect.
Keep fixes general so every coupon and quantity behaves correctly.
constraints: Work in integer cents; never use floating point.
Ignore lines whose quantity is zero or negative.
SAVE10 applies only when the subtotal is at least 5000 cents.
SAVE25 applies only when the subtotal is at least 10000 cents.
The discount is the integer floor of subtotal * percent / 100.
Trim and upper-case the coupon before matching.

examples.explanation: The subtotal is 6000 and the discount is 600.
The discount floors to 555 cents instead of rounding.

public.name: Line quantities
public.description: Non-positive quantities must not change the subtotal.

public.name: Discount threshold
public.description: A subtotal exactly at the threshold receives the discount.

hidden.name: Quantity guards
hidden.description: Zero, negative, and empty carts are handled without special cases.

hidden.name: Threshold boundaries
hidden.description: Both coupons switch on exactly at their threshold and no earlier.

hidden.name: Discount rounding
hidden.description: Discounts floor instead of rounding up.

hidden.name: Coupon normalization
hidden.description: Case and surrounding whitespace do not change the coupon.
